author: isaac_t

title: Great day at Montserrat Monastery and beautiful hike
text: The trip to the Monastery and the hike up the mountain were beautiful experiences.  Eugenia, my quide was very knowledgeable about the story of the site, the geography of the region and made me feel very confortable throughout the hike.  Despite the cold and rainy weather, she made the experience wonderful.  She messaged me the day before to ensure I was properly dressed given the weather forecast and brought additional clothes for me just in case.   She checked with me throughout the day to ensure I was not too cold or tired.  I highly recommend the experience.  Beautiful time in nature.
author: Clara_P
